findings.summary: In axis-position-nova.svg the vertical panel's scale is set by one slice, so the comparison the caption describes cannot be read from the panel. The excursion near slice 40 drops about 6 mm below the rest of the trace, so the panel spans roughly 11 mm with ticks only at 0.498 and 0.493, while the vertical scatter away from that slice is a few tenths of a millimetre — about five rendered pixels. Measured from the PNG: the blue trace occupies rows 460-592 of a 212-pixel panel, and more than half of that is the single excursion. A reader sees a flat jagged band and can neither read the size nor the memory of the vertical motion that the caption says the lag-one measures. The excursion is real measured data and the caption explains it, which is why this records rather than holds the node.

In axis-position-nova.svg the dotted generating-state line is invisible in the vertical panel, though the caption names it. The reference sits at Z 0.498205, which is inside the dense band both traces occupy, so it is drawn beneath them and covered; searching the panel's rows for the reference's four-pixel dotted period across the full width returns none, while the same detector finds the line in the radial panels (y=218 here, y=263 in the imas-efit figure) and in the imas-efit vertical panel (row 539). A reader is told to read the trace against a reference that is not on the page in that panel; the caption's value keeps it usable.

In slice-overlay-drift-101.svg every null marker encodes its series rather than its null type, and no legend or caption defines the shapes. nova keeps the project vocabulary (filled triangle for the axis at line 118, filled plus for the saddle at line 130), but imas-efit's axis is an open square and its saddle an open diamond, and the generating state's axis an open circle and its saddle a cross, so a reader cannot tell, for imas-efit or the generating state, which mark is the axis and which the saddle. The three axis marks sit within about two millimetres at machine scale and overlap into one cluster at the plasma centre, which the caption's millimetre annotation compensates for but does not explain.

notes: Read-only figure review: no file was edited, created or moved, and the record is the only deliverable. The three attached PNGs were opened with the Read tool and judged on their rendered pixels; no SVG was read, rendered, listed or shown, and no image other than the three named PNGs was opened. Measurements quoted here (white-pixel fractions, colour values and contrast ratios, ink bounding boxes, panel pixel geometry and the dotted-line row search) were computed from those same PNGs. The PNG-to-figure mapping comes from attachment order, the legend colour (green is imas-efit, blue is nova, which the overlay caption also states) and the caption text. The diagnoses for the first two findings are anchored to the drawing script lines the run's diff shows; both figures are unchanged in this head only in data, so the layout is the script's.
